name: Open-source maintainer to contributor
description: Reconnects with people who starred or forked a repository and opens a conversation about contributing.
audience: Developers who starred or forked your repository and may be interested in contributing.

variants: Hi {{firstName|there}} — I follow the work coming out of {{company|your team}} and would rather read your posts in my feed than miss them. Happy to connect.
Hi {{firstName|there}}, your work as {{title|a leader}} at {{company|your company}} keeps crossing my feed. Would be good to connect properly.
Thanks for connecting, {{firstName|there}}. No pitch — I mostly wanted to follow what {{company|your team}} is building. What's taking up most of your time this quarter?
Appreciate the connect, {{firstName|there}}. Genuinely curious what the next six months look like for {{company|your team}} — what's the thing you keep coming back to?
No worries if this isn't a good moment, {{firstName|there}}. I'll stay out of your inbox — if the {{company|your team}} roadmap ever needs an outside pair of eyes, I'm here.
Last one from me, {{firstName|there}} — I'll leave you to it. Ping me any time if something at {{company|your company}} is worth a conversation.
